ValidationRule.description: Once the booking was already approved (or past New) before the save, the first applicant details change only through an approved First Applicant Change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISCHANGED(Last_First_Applicant_Change_Id__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Booking_Verification_Approval_Status__c), "Approved"), NOT(OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "New"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Pending Verification"))) ), OR( ISCHANGED(First_Applicant_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Email__c), ISCHANGED(Mobile__c), ISCHANGED(Salutation__c), ISCHANGED(S_o_D_o_W_o__c), ISCHANGED(Son_Daughter_Wife_of__c), ISCHANGED(Date_of_Birth__c), ISCHANGED(PAN_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Aadhaar__c), ISCHANGED(Nationality__c), ISCHANGED(Residential_Status__c), ISCHANGED(Marital_Status__c), ISCHANGED(Passport_PI_no__c), ISCHANGED(Occupation__c), ISCHANGED(Permanent_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Correspondence_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Office_Address__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The booking is approved, so the first applicant details cannot be edited here. Raise a First Applicant Change from the booking instead.
